description:
Create a new Group Alias and assign it to the 'RETENTION' campaign to standardize outbound Caller ID identity.

1. Go to the Admin > Group Aliases section.
2. Create a new Group Alias with these EXACT details:
   - Group Alias ID: RETENTION_HQ
   - Group Alias Name: Retention Team Main Identity
   - Caller ID Number: 8005550155
   - Caller ID Name: RETENTION SVC
   - Active: Y
   - Admin Group: --ALL--
3. Go to the Campaigns section and modify the 'Customer Retention' campaign (ID: RETENTION).
4. Set the 'Default Group Alias' field to your new alias (RETENTION_HQ).
5. Save changes.
